messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **federal public holidays** in Canada for 2023 that create **long weekends** (i.e., a holiday falling on a weekday or being observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend).  
For each holiday, I've noted the actual date, the observed date (if applicable), and the span of the long weekend.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed On | Long Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday, Jan 1 | Monday, Jan 2 | Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 2 |
| Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Monday, Feb 20 | — | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Friday, Apr 7 | — | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day | Monday, May 22 | — | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 |
| Canada Day | Saturday, Jul 1 | Monday, Jul 3 | Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | Monday, Sep 4 | — | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Monday, Oct 9 | — | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Saturday, Nov 11 | Monday, Nov 13 | Sat Nov 11 – Mon Nov 13 |
| Christmas Day | Monday, Dec 25 | — | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday, Dec 26 | — | Sat Dec 23 – Tue Dec 27 |

> **Notes**
> - Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.). If your app needs those, let me know which provinces you’re targeting.
> - When a holiday falls on a weekend, the *observed* day is usually the following Monday, creating a three‑day weekend.
> - For holidays that already fall on a Monday (e.g., Family Day, Victoria Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas), the long weekend spans the preceding Saturday through the holiday Monday.

Feel free to copy this table directly into your holiday‑planning app. Let me know if you’d like the data in a specific format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need provincial variations!
